shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- index ---\\n' && cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat src/vite-env.d.ts && cat vite.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && rg "Markdown|markdown" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/esm 2>/dev/null | head -50'

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "declare const Card|export.*Card;|declare const Text|export.*Text;" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -20; rg -n "''^export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -5'
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v applypatch || command -v apply-patch || find / -name apply_patch -type f 2>/dev/null | head'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/markdown.test.ts && npx vitest --run && npm run build'
